parsed.notes: Leverage limit is 3.75x, stepping up to 4.25x after a significant acquisition. The interest coverage requirement is stated as greater than 3.00x. The 3.50x leverage threshold is a dividend restriction, and the pricing grid ratios only set interest spreads, so neither is reported as a separate covenant. The company states it was in compliance at 2026-09-30.
